# ex: implicit deref applied in non-selector substitution context
ex {
	var t T
	F(t) -> G(t)
}
-- x.go --
package m

type T struct{ X int }

func F(t T) int { return t.X }
func G(t T) int { return t.X + 1 }

func H(p *T) int {
	return F(*p)
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -6,5 +6,5 @@
 func G(t T) int { return t.X + 1 }

 func H(p *T) int {
-	return F(*p)
+	return G(*p)
 }
